result.finding: No Docker VOLUME instructions, docker-compose.yml volume definitions, or Kubernetes PersistentVolumeClaim configurations exist in the project. In the dev profile, the web module uses a local filesystem directory (default: '../storage') for file storage, which would require a volume mount if containerized. In production, files are stored in AWS S3, making local volume mounts unnecessary. The generated Dockerfiles do not declare any VOLUME instructions.
evidence: No VOLUME instruction in generated Dockerfiles (scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh lines 272-295)
web/LocalFileStorageService.java: uses '@Value("${local.storage.directory:../storage}")' for local file storage (dev profile only)
Production profile uses AWS S3 (AwsS3Service) — no local volume needed
values: Dev profile: local filesystem at '../storage' (relative path) — not containerized
Production profile: AWS S3 — no volume mount required
Database (PostgreSQL) and messaging (RabbitMQ) run as separate infrastructure containers without defined volume mounts in project config
